name: dsh-ppt-forge
description: Free PPT generation for DeepSeek Harness: mounts the ppt-master (native PPTX) and guizang-ppt-skill (single-file HTML deck) agent skills and exposes setup/export/validate tools. The skills are fetched unmodified from their upstream repositories and keep their own licenses.
